title: A Multispectral Framework for the Detection of Calcium Carbide-Induced Ripening and Shelf-Life Estimation in Climacteric Fruits
abstract: arXiv:2608.13073v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Significant health risks are associated with the illegal, yet commonly practiced use of industrial-grade Calcium Carbide (CaC2) for ripening climacteric fruits like mango and banana, which leaves behind trace residues of arsenic and phosphorus. To address this, the proposed study explores a novel, non-invasive multispectral framework for distinguishing safely ripened fruits (naturally ripened and ethephon-induced) from calcium carbide-ripened samples, while also estimating their ripening progression (in percentage) and remaining shelf life (in days). The spectral profiles of mango (Mangifera indica) and banana (Musa acuminata) at 18 discrete wavelengths in the visible-near infrared (NIR) range (410 nm - 940 nm) are studied using the AS7265x spectral triad sensor. CaC2-treated samples exhibit sharper spectral intensity drops in the visible region, consistent with accelerated chlorophyll degradation and carotenoid development. To character

translated_title: 一种用于检测乙烯利诱导催熟和呼吸跃变型水果货架期估计的多光谱框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：使用工业级碳化钙（CaC2）催熟芒果和香蕉等呼吸跃变型水果是非法但常见的做法，会留下砷和磷的痕量残留物，带来显著的健康风险。为解决这一问题，本研究提出了一种新颖的非侵入性多光谱框架，用于区分安全催熟的水果（自然成熟和乙烯利诱导）与碳化钙催熟的样本，同时估算其催熟进度（百分比）和剩余货架期（天数）。使用AS7265x光谱三合一传感器，研究了芒果（Mangifera indica）和香蕉（Musa acuminata）在可见光-近红外（NIR）范围（410 nm - 940 nm）内18个离散波长的光谱特征。经CaC2处理的样本在可见光区域表现出更明显的光谱强度下降，这与叶绿素加速降解和类胡萝卜素发育一致。为了表征...
tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于多光谱传感的非侵入性框架，能够区分碳化钙催熟与安全催熟的水果，并估算其催熟程度和剩余货架期，以应对非法催熟带来的健康风险。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a novel multispectral framework for non-invasively distinguishing calcium carbide-ripened fruits from safely ripened ones and estimating ripening progression and shelf life, addressing health risks from illegal ripening practices.
